title: Stop Looking in Killeen — This Is Copperas Cove Living (Big Lot, No HOA)

This is what Copperas Cove living should be. 🌳
https://www.homes.com/property/351-summers-road-copperas-cove-tx/bb6bgtdg9w1c9/
351 Somers Rd sits on a little over half an acre with mature trees, a huge backyard, and no HOA. You get that country feel without being “out in the country” — you’re about:

🚗 ~10 minutes to H-E-B

🚗 ~5 minutes to new development & Copperas Cove City Park

🎬 A quick drive to Synergy Movie Theater (Cove’s main hangout spot)

🚙 About 15–20 minutes to Fort Cavazos

The house itself is a 3 bed, 2 bath, ~1,500+ sq ft with:

Fresh interior & exterior paint

New flooring in the main areas and wet spaces

Brand new roof going on

New AC unit (Texas non-negotiable)

Split floor plan, high ceilings, and tons of natural light

Cool butler’s pantry / laundry connection

Big primary suite with a bonus nook for office, reading, or “zen mode”

If you’ve been debating Killeen vs. Cove vs. Temple/Belton, this will show you what you can get in Copperas Cove at this price point: space, privacy, and freedom from HOAs.
